quality of intergroup contact is associated with greater agreeability and openness to experience and agreeability and openness predict greater quality of contact, whereas quantity of contact is negatively associated with agreeability.
intergroup contact is related to agreeableness and open-mindedness, and that these personality traits are related to intergroup contact.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between intergroup relations and personality.
the relationship between personality traits and intergroup contact and the role of personality in predicting contact and the role played by contact in shaping personality.
the question of what makes people more open to contact with others.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effects of intergroup contact on personality traits are not as simple as they seem, and the effects of personality traits on intergroup contact are even more complicated.
intergroup contact is a two-way street: It is influenced by personality traits but it also affects personality traits.
intergroup contact and agreeabeness have an influence on each other.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the more you are open to experience and agreeable, the more you are likely to seek contact with outgroups, and the more you seek contact with out-groups the more you are going to become more open to experience and more agreeable.
personality traits and intergroup contact can be seen as two sides of the same coin: they influence and are influenced by each other.
personality traits are important for intergroup contact, but intergroup contact is important for personality as well.
The main takeaway from our work is that
intergroup contact is not only predicted by personality, as previous research has shown, but it also affects personality traits.
intergroup contact can be a powerful tool for personality development, especially for the development of agreeableness and of openness to experience.
intergroup contact is not only a consequence of personality but also a predictor of personality.
